Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 38 s. 2023 May 15, 2023 DIRECTOR JONATHAN PAUL M. LEUSEN, JR. Regional Director, DILG-RegionaI Office II Regional Government Center, Carig Sur Tuguegarao City, Cagayan Dear RD Leusen, Jr.: This has reference to your Memorandum dated October 13, 2022 seeking clarification regarding the filling up of vacancy in the Office of the President of the Panlalawigang Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan. Per the documents forwarded to the Central Office, hereunder are the relevant factual antecedents: l. Hon. Argel E. Hortiz, incumbent SK Panlalawigang Pederasyon President of Batanes was elected as Vice Mayor of Uyugan, Batanes in the 2022 General Elections, creating a vacancy in in the Office of the President of the Panlalawigang Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan in the Province of Batanes 2. In view thereof and in reply to the query of DILG-Provincial Office-Batanes, the DILG Regional Office II advised the Provincial Office to conduct a Special Election in coordination with the Commission on Elections for the purpose of filling up vacancies in the Office of the SK Panlalawigang Pederasyon President. 3. The advised given was anchored on Section 41 (a)(4) of DILG-COMELEC-NYC JMC No. 2017-011, which states that: "SECTION 41. FILLING UP OF VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF THE PEDERASYON PRESIDENT a. PERMANENT VACANCY — In case the Pederasyon President voluntarily resigns, dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, or has been absent without leave for more than three consecutive months, the Vice President of the concemed Pederasyon shall: Guidelines on the Conduct of Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Pederasyon Election and Rules Governing Terms of Office, Suspension and Removal of All SK Pederasyon. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

xxx 4. Special election shall be held to elect the Vice President of the Pederasyon from among the other officers of the Pederasyon " 4. It is your opinion that there can be no automatic succession by the Vice President of concerned Pederasyon considering that assumption to higher office or any other offices analogous to the latter is not included on the grounds enumerated in Section 41(a) of JMC No. 2017-012. 5. Comes now, on 6 October 2022, DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2022-1303 was issued. Specifically, the 3rd paragraph of said Circular provides that: "Relatedly, Section 1 of Memorandum Circular No. 151, s. 1992 provides that "permanent vacancy arises when an incumbent elective official fills a higher vacant office, refuses to assume office, fails to qualify, dies, is removed from office, voluntarily resigns, or is otherwise permanently incapacitated to discharge the functions of his office". 6. The interpretation presented by the Region is that the above cited provision of MC No. 2022-130 contradicts with Section 41 of DILG-COMELEC-NYC JMC No. 2017-01 Anent thereto, the following issues are sought to be clarified: 1. What is the legal basis on the inclusion of assumption to a higher office as a ground of permanent vacancy in the office the Barangay, Sangguniang Kabataan, LNB, or in SK Pederasyon as this case? 2. What is the remedy available, if any, on the said conduct of Special Elections given the glaring disparity in the enumeration of the instances of permanent vacancy set forth in DILG-MC 2022-130 and COMELEC- DILG-NYC JMC No. 2017-01? 3. May the result of the said special elections remain in status quo as to deem it final and unalterable with the issuance of the MC 2022-130? We deemed it wise to address the foregoing questions in one discussion as they are interrelated. With due respect to the position of DILG-Region II, this Level has a different view. 2 PERMANENT VACANCY — In case the Pederayon President voluntarily resigns. dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, or has been absent without leave for more than there consecutive months. the Vice President of the concerned Pederasyon shall: xxx 3 Manner of Filling Up of Vacancy in the Barangay, Sangguniang Kabataan (SK), Liga ng mga Barangay and Pederasyon ng mga SK due to the Assumption to Higher Position/office of BSKOs who won in the May 09, 2022 National and Local Elections Page 2 of 5

Assumption to Higher Office Will Give Rise to a permanent Vacancy We begin our discussion by partly quoting the Supreme Court's ratiocination in the case of Aurelio D. Menzon v. Leopoldo E. Petilla, et al.4, thus: "Sensu contrario, there is a vacancy when there is no person lawfully authorized to assume and exercise at present the duties of the office. " It should be noted that the mechanism for filling up permanent vacancies in the Office of Pederasyon President is found in Section 41 of DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-01, viz: "SECTION 41. FILLING UP OF VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF THE PEDERASYON PRESIDENT a. PERMANENT VACANCY — In case the Pederasyon President voluntarily resigns, dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, or has been absent without leave for more than three consecutive months, the Vice President of the concerned Pederasyon shall: 1. Automatically assume the office for the unexpired portion of the term; [Emphasis Supplied] 2. Discharge the powers and duties of the pederasyon president; 3. Enjoy the rights and privileges appurtenant to the office including representation in the local sanggunian and the receipt of the corresponding monetary renumeration for the services rendered; It is categorical in the aforementioned provision that the assumption of the Vice Pederasyon President is automatic by the use of the word "shall" in the phrase ".... the Vice President of the concerned Pederasyon President shall automatically assume the office...." However, instead of allowing automatic succession to take place, the DILG Provincial Office of Batanes resorted to the conduct of Special Election pursuant to Section 41(a)(4) of JMC 2017-01. We have to digress. Section 41(a)(4) of JMC 2017- 01 relevantly states: SECTION 41. FILLING UP OF VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF THE PEDERASYON PRESIDENT a. PERMANENT VACANCY 4 G.R. No. 90762, May 20, 1991. Page 3 of 5

xxxx 4. Special election shall be held to elect the Vice President of the Pederasyon from among the other officers of the Pederasyon [Emphasis Supplied] Based on the import of the quoted provision, the conduct of special election is only for the purpose of electing the Vice President of the Pederasyon. It contemplates a situation where the vacancy is by virtue of the incumbent Vice President's automatic assumption of the position of President because of the President's resignation: death. incapacity. removal from office or absence without leave. A cardinal rule in statutory construction is that when the language of the law is clear, explicit and unequivocal, there is no room for construction or interpretation. There is only room for application. This is what is known as the plain-meaning rule or verba legis as expressed in the maxim, index animi sermo, or "from the words of a statute there should be no departure." In view thereof, we opine that the conduct of the special election to fill up the vacancy in the position of the SK Pederasyon President is without legal basis. Section 41(a) of JMC No. 2017-01 does not textually state "assumption to higher office" as one of the grounds that will give way to a permanent vacancy in the Office of the SK Pederasyon President. Hence, the assumption of SK Pederasyon President Argel E. Hortiz as Vice Mayor of Uyugan should be looked into. When SK Pederasyon President Hortiz assumes his new position as Vice Mayor, he ceases to be an inhabitant of the office for which he was priorly elected and can no longer discharge the duties of his office. Envisaging the herein situation come June 30, 2022, there will be no official who will sit as SK Pederasyon President, therefore, the same can be considered permanently vacant. Therefore, assumption to higher office, though not categorically enumerated in Section 41 (a), is akin and analogous thereto. There is no question then that the rule on succession under Section 41 (a)(l) will be automatically applicable. For it is an accepted axiom that Ubi eadem ratio, ibi eadem lex. The principle states that, where the same reason exists, there the same law prevails. Effect of the Special Election Disposing the issue of vacancy, we come now to the next issue on whether the result of the special election may be given effect. We interpose a qualified answer thereto. To our mind, pivotal in the ascertainment of the resolution to this query, is the determination on who emerged as the winner during the Special Election conducted. It is our submission that if the elected new Pederasyon President is the sitting Pederasyon Vice President, he can continue discharging the powers functions appurtenant to the office, not by virtue of the Special Election, but pursuant to the rule on automatic Page 4 of 5

succession under Section 41 (a)(l) of JMC 2017-01. To reiterate, the assumption of the Pederasyon Vice-President shall be automatic and there is no need for any other legal requirement except to prove that a permanent vacancy has occurred with the successor serving only the unexpired term. If the elected new Pederasyon President is other than the incumbent Pederasyon Vice President, we are of the opinion that his or her election thereto may be rendered functus officio or without any effect since his authority is derived from an irregular election. Election has no legal effect for being contrary to law. This opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same, and rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope the foregoing sufficiently clarified your queries. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: A CTOR R.
